packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major Go module updates; majors still need manual review. CI (the branch checks) gates every merge.
Always track the latest GitHub Actions (including major bumps) and auto-merge. config:best-practices pins each action to a commit SHA; CI gates the merge.

Rebuild and commit the vendored SvelteKit SPA whenever a ui/ dependency changes, so the 'ui vendored-asset drift' check stays green (the UI analog of gomodTidy). Requires the self-hosted bot to allow this command via allowedPostUpgradeCommands and to have node + pnpm available.

commands: cd ui && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && rm -rf ../internal/webauth/static && mkdir -p ../internal/webauth/static && cp -R build/. ../internal/webauth/static/

packageRules.description: Block cookie major bumps: cookie v2 is an ESM-only API rewrite (parse→parseCookie, serialize→stringifyCookie) that @sveltejs/kit 2.68.0 does not support — a v2 bump breaks the SPA build at the pnpm build step (caught by the 'ui vendored-asset drift' check). The ui/pnpm-workspace.yaml override forces cookie up only to clear GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x (cookie <0.7.0); ^1.0.0 already clears it, so v2 adds no security value. Minor/patch within 1.x remain allowed.
